import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def blocks_of(g,line):
    h=len(g);w=len(g[0])
    hr=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==line for v in g[r])]

def solve(g,line):
    h=len(g);w=len(g[0])
    hr=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==line for v in g[r])]
    rb=[];s=0
    for s2 in hr+[h]:
        if s2-s>1: rb.append((s,s2-1)); s=s2+1
    hc=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==line for r in range(h))]
    cb=[];s=0
    for s2 in hc+[w]:
        if s2-s>1: cb.append((s,s2-1)); s=s2+1
    # per band: color = most common nonzero-non-line value in the band; pattern = union of all such cells in band
    out=[[g[r][c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    for i,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rb):
        vals=[(r-r0,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (0,line)]
        if not vals: continue
        col=max(set(v for _,_,v in [(0,0,g[r][c]) for r,c in vals]), key=lambda v:sum(g[r0+a][c]==v for a,b in [(r-r0,c)])) if False else None
        cnt={}
        for r,c in vals: cnt[g[r][c]]=cnt.get(g[r][c],0)+1
        col=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
        pat=set(vals)
        # normalize: shift so min col of pattern -> 0? Instead anchor pattern at each block's matching column alignment: copy cells with absolute positions, but stamp so pattern starts at each block's local (same col offset within block).
        for j,(c0,c1) in enumerate(cb):
            for r,c in pat:
                rr=r; cc=c-c0  # preserve absolute row within band, col offset relative to block start
                if cc<=c1-c0:
                    out[rr][cc]=col
    return out
